thread:
samir: Drafting Skyline private-offer for marketplace + ChannelResell. Need quick takes on SKU parity across regions, escrowed trial pool, appliance consignment, and renewal rollover rules. @anya @derek pls
anya: For APAC/EU we should publish local-currency SKUs and keep a small FX buffer. Suggest local SKU + 1.8% FX cushion for <$200k orders.
derek: Sales: propose $20k seed band to reduce friction and a $30k named-prospect POC pool. Also require a 50% usage floor in first 6 months to qualify for renewal rollover.
julia: Finance: tiers 20k/250k/1.0M with discounts 7%/14%/22%. Renewal rollover = on-invoice credit that can carry over up to 180 days, capped at 25% of next-year invoice. Need blended margin calc before signoff.
finance-bot: Reminder: attach cost-model when posting margins (template link).
ops-bot: Note: consigned HW requires customs lead time and export review; delivery triggers invoice credit.
samir: Quick sample terms below, call out blocking concerns only:
```
Skyline x ChannelResell - Private Marketplace Offer (draft)
Bands:
- Seed: $20,000 commit -> 7% discount, $30k POC credits (named), 3mo activation
- Growth: $250,000 commit -> 14% discount, 12% on-invoice rollover credit, 9mo activation
- Scale: $1,000,000 commit -> 22% discount, 20% on-invoice rollover credit, 12mo activation
POC bucket: $30k API credits, non-transferable, gated to named prospects, expires 90 days
HW consignment: up to $100k appliance consignment per account; invoice credit after deployment + customs clearance; shipments > $60k require export sign-off
Currency & SKU parity: publish USD/public-token SKU + EUR/JPY local SKUs where partner demand exists; FX cushion 1.8% for orders < $200k; annual FX reconciliation in contract
Renewal rollover: on-invoice credit applied at renewal or as monthly line item, carryover up to 180 days, capped at 25% of next-year invoice; requires 50% usage floor in first 6 months to qualify
Marketplace listing: private SKU mapping for SI-led deals; public listing after partner signoff; partner co-marketing fund $25k on Growth+ 12mo commit
```
anya: Please ensure trial gating to named prospects only and non-transferable.
derek: I'll add sale play to prevent trial gaming. Also want a modest overachievement bonus (3% credit) if customer exceeds commit by >30% in year. Cap at 5% total bonus credits.
julia: I'll run blended margin and post the cost-model by Thu EOD. Also want a clause that prevents double-dipping between POC credits and renewal rollover.
samir: Actions: @julia margin + cost-model, @derek sales gating list + overachievement language, @anya confirm local SKU ops, @legal to redline export + rollover language. Partner preview Wed 11am PT. Thanks all.
